review.note: a shell is asked to execute '-'

category5.design: A free Ruby script as PoV could read files, run commands and act per build, so the PoV is data for a fixed Ruby script run by the project's mruby_fuzzer: it calls IO._popen(command, mode) and prints the pid of the started child; the rule matches an integer pid in the vulnerable build and its absence (pid=nil) in the fixed one. Any command other than '-' forks in both builds.
